ab_interpretation: Cost is ~4.67x baseline. Decomposition: this run used claude-opus-4.7 vs v0.3.6's claude-sonnet-4.6 (5x input/output rate, 5x cache rates). Same monolithic A9+A7 shape, zero task() spawns in both runs. If we normalize to sonnet-4.6 rates the equivalent cost would be ~$9.16 (input 2555935*3 + output 24490*15 + cache_read 2445198*0.30 + cache_write 103713*3.75 / 1M = 9156.87/1M = $9.157), which is BELOW v0.3.6's $9.7956 despite more cache-write churn. v0.3.7 introduces zero substrate overhead on this shape — design plan §3 prediction CONFIRMED. The absolute-dollar overshoot is purely model-class, not architectural.
